description: Phase 4 backbone: extend the pure rewards domain (src/domain/rewards/index.ts) with the deterministic, idempotent, injected-clock XP/streak/badge model and its unit tests. No react/react-native/AsyncStorage imports; the domain never calls Date(). Independent of the coaching domain (FEAT-002); everything else depends on this.
steps: In src/domain/rewards/index.ts, KEEP the existing LevelCompletedEvent and deriveCompletionEvents. Add: REWARDS_STATE_VERSION = 2; type LocalDateYYYYMMDD = string; interfaces StreakState { count: number; lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD: LocalDateYYYYMMDD | null }, RewardsState { version: 2; awardedXp: Record<string, number>; totalXp: number; streak: StreakState; earnedBadges: string[] }; RewardSource discriminated union ({ kind:'lesson-completed'; trackId; levelId: LevelId; lessonId } | { kind:'mastery-passed'; trackId; levelId: LevelId }); RewardOutcome { state; xpAwarded; alreadyAwarded; streakIncreased; streakReset; newStreakCount; badgeEarned: string | null }; RewardsView { totalXp; streakCount; lastActivityDate; earnedBadgeCount; hasBadge(trackId, levelId): boolean }; Clock { nowEpochMs(): number; localDateYYYYMMDD(): LocalDateYYYYMMDD }.
Add class RewardError extends Error (set this.name = 'RewardError'), mirroring ProgressionError in src/domain/progression/index.ts.
Add emptyRewards(): RewardsState returning { version:2, awardedXp:{}, totalXp:0, streak:{count:0, lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD:null}, earnedBadges:[] }.

Add pure daysBetweenLocalDates(from, to): number returning the SIGNED civil-day delta (to - from) by parsing each 8-digit YYYYMMDD into civil Y/M/D and doing civil-date math (do NOT construct a timezone-bearing Date for the arithmetic). Throw RewardError('malformed local date') ONLY when an argument is not 8 parseable digits; a valid-but-earlier `to` returns a negative number (never throws).

Add applyReward(prev, source, clock): RewardOutcome per design 3.4, never mutating prev. Compute the ledger key: lesson -> source.lessonId verbatim; mastery -> `mastery:${trackId}/${levelId}`. Validate ids are non-empty strings (else RewardError('<field> must be a non-empty string')); defensive default on source.kind throws RewardError('unknown reward source'). If key already in prev.awardedXp: RETURN prev BY REFERENCE with xpAwarded:0, alreadyAwarded:true, streakIncreased:false, streakReset:false, newStreakCount:prev.streak.count, badgeEarned:null. Else first-time: xp = lesson?20:50; awardedXp' = {...prev.awardedXp,[key]:xp}; totalXp' = prev.totalXp + xp. Streak with today = clock.localDateYYYYMMDD(), branches IN ORDER: (a) prev.streak.lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD===null -> count=1, streakIncreased:true, set last=today; else delta = daysBetweenLocalDates(last, today): (b) delta<0 -> no change (streakIncreased:false, streakReset:false, last unchanged); (c) delta===0 -> no change; (d) delta===1 -> count=prev.count+1, streakIncreased:true, set last=today; (e) delta>=2 -> count=1, streakReset:true, streakIncreased:true, set last=today. badgeEarned is always null here (badges are applied by applyBadge). Maintain totalXp === sum(values(awardedXp)) and the invariant lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD !== null => count >= 1.

Add applyBadge(prev, events: LevelCompletedEvent[]): { state: RewardsState; badgeEarned: string | null }. For each event append badge id `${trackId}/${levelId}` to earnedBadges if not already present (de-duped, append-only). Idempotent. Return the (possibly unchanged) state and the single newly-earned badge id (or null).
Add viewRewards(state): RewardsView with hasBadge(trackId, levelId) === state.earnedBadges.includes(`${trackId}/${levelId}`).

Extend __tests__/rewards.test.ts (keep the existing deriveCompletionEvents tests) with a FakeClock test helper (settable localDateYYYYMMDD) and design section 8 items 1-11: first lesson=20XP+key+totalXp===20; repeat=0+alreadyAwarded+state returned by reference+totalXp unchanged; first mastery pass=50 under mastery:track/level, fail=0 no key; repeat mastery=0; totalXp===sum(values(awardedXp)) after each; streak first(1)/same-day(1)/consecutive(2)/gap(reset 1) with correct flags; streak unmoved on a repeat; backwards clock -> no streak change but XP awarded; applyBadge appends once / replay no-op / two levels two badges / empty events no badge; RewardError on malformed date and empty-id source; viewRewards totals/streak/badge-count/hasBadge; the lastDate!=null=>count>=1 invariant after first and consecutive credits.
acceptance_criteria: src/domain/rewards/index.ts exports RewardsState, StreakState, RewardSource, RewardOutcome, RewardsView, Clock, RewardError, REWARDS_STATE_VERSION, emptyRewards, applyReward, applyBadge, viewRewards, daysBetweenLocalDates, and still exports LevelCompletedEvent + deriveCompletionEvents.
The module imports nothing from react/react-native/@react-native-async-storage and contains no Date() / Date.now() call.
applyReward is idempotent (a repeat returns the prior state by reference, awards 0 XP, and moves no streak) and the streak branches resolve delta<0 before the gap arm.
Running `npm test -- rewards` passes all new and existing cases.
verification: npm run lint   clean on src/domain/rewards/index.ts and __tests__/rewards.test.ts
findings:
Implemented in src/domain/rewards/index.ts (pure TS, no react/react-native/AsyncStorage, no Date()). LevelCompletedEvent + deriveCompletionEvents kept unchanged.

Exact exported symbols/signatures later features must bind to:
- const REWARDS_STATE_VERSION = 2
- type LocalDateYYYYMMDD = string (an 8-digit YYYYMMDD local calendar string)
- interface StreakState { count: number; lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD: LocalDateYYYYMMDD | null }
- interface RewardsState { version: 2; awardedXp: Record<string, number>; totalXp: number; streak: StreakState; earnedBadges: string[] }
- type RewardSource = { kind: 'lesson-completed'; trackId: string; levelId: LevelId; lessonId: string } | { kind: 'mastery-passed'; trackId: string; levelId: LevelId }
- interface RewardOutcome { state: RewardsState; xpAwarded: number; alreadyAwarded: boolean; streakIncreased: boolean; streakReset: boolean; newStreakCount: number; badgeEarned: string | null }
- interface RewardsView { totalXp: number; streakCount: number; lastActivityDate: LocalDateYYYYMMDD | null; earnedBadgeCount: number; hasBadge(trackId: string, levelId: LevelId): boolean }
- interface Clock { nowEpochMs(): number; localDateYYYYMMDD(): LocalDateYYYYMMDD }  (domain only ever sees this interface; the production systemClock belongs in src/ui/rewards/systemClock.ts per design — NOT created by this feature)
- class RewardError extends Error (name = 'RewardError')
- function emptyRewards(): RewardsState  -> { version:2, awardedXp:{}, totalXp:0, streak:{count:0,lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD:null}, earnedBadges:[] }
- function daysBetweenLocalDates(from: LocalDateYYYYMMDD, to: LocalDateYYYYMMDD): number  (SIGNED civil-day delta to-from via Hinnant civil algorithm; throws RewardError('malformed local date') ONLY when an arg is not 8 parseable digits; a valid-but-earlier `to` returns negative, never throws)
- function applyReward(prev: RewardsState, source: RewardSource, clock: Clock): RewardOutcome  (never mutates prev; on repeat returns prev BY REFERENCE with xpAwarded:0/alreadyAwarded:true; first-time xp=lesson?20:50; streak branches in order a null / b delta<0 (no move, XP still awarded) / c delta===0 / d delta===1 (count+1) / e delta>=2 (reset to 1, streakReset+streakIncreased both true); badgeEarned always null here)
- function applyBadge(prev: RewardsState, events: LevelCompletedEvent[]): { state: RewardsState; badgeEarned: string | null }  (append-only de-dup; no-op returns prev by reference and badgeEarned null; badgeEarned is the FIRST newly-added id)
- function viewRewards(state: RewardsState): RewardsView

Ledger key format (binding, used by applyReward and must be reproduced by any persistence guard re-derivation):
- lesson key = source.lessonId VERBATIM (Phase 2 lesson ids are globally unique)
- mastery key = `mastery:${trackId}/${levelId}`
- badge id / earnedBadges entries = `${trackId}/${levelId}`
- totalXp invariant: totalXp === sum(Object.values(awardedXp)) after every transition; streak invariant: lastLocalDateYYYYMMDD !== null => count >= 1.

FakeClock test-helper shape (in __tests__/rewards.test.ts, reusable pattern for store/screen tests): `class FakeClock implements Clock { constructor(date: string, epoch = 0); nowEpochMs(): number; localDateYYYYMMDD(): string; set(date: string, epoch?: number): void }` — a mutable settable-date clock; advance via clock.set('20250201') between applyReward calls to exercise streak branches.

Verification run green: npm run typecheck exit 0; npm test -- rewards = 22 passed; npm run lint exit 0 (only 2 pre-existing require-import WARNINGS in __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx and __tests__/store.test.ts, not in this feature's files).
